text: In Cambodia cattle are often kept under the house or in a small cowshed nearby. It is recommended to protect the area with a mosquito net — mosquitoes do not transmit disease to cattle directly, but repeated night-time biting disturbs sleep and reduces daytime eating, harming overall condition. Cattle also need a shady place to eat and ruminate (under trees or a roof) and shelter from heavy rain and lightning. Grass should be distributed in a proper container to prevent waste and ensure fair access for each animal. Building a crush (restraint structure) is a good investment for safe handling during examination or medicine injection, for both farmer and veterinarian.
